data.title: Bußgeldbescheid: Speeding fine of €147.00
data.summary: The Bußgeldstelle of Landkreis Musterammerland issued a Bußgeldbescheid (fine notice) for exceeding the 30 km/h speed limit near a school by 18 km/h on 23 September 2026. The total amount due is €147.00 (fine €115.00, fee €28.50, delivery costs €3.50) and one point is recorded in the Fahreignungsregister.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice from the local traffic authority (Bußgeldstelle) for a speeding offence. You can decide whether to accept it or to file an objection (Einspruch) in writing or on record at the Bußgeldstelle — the app shows the deadline for this. If you don't object in time, the notice becomes legally final and the full amount must be paid two weeks after that happens; the exact payment date isn't fixed yet because it only starts once the notice is final. If you're unsure whether to object, consider getting advice from a traffic lawyer (Verkehrsanwalt) or ADAC/ACE before the deadline. Ignoring it can lead to enforcement action.
data.tax_note: A traffic speeding fine is a personal penalty and is not tax-deductible.
